messages:
Maria: quick sync — proposing we onboard rwd-v2.4-int4q using a phased lockstep promote + auto-fallback. goal: low-risk exposure for quantized model, fast rollback if quality drops.

Sam: can you paste the rollout config you have in mind? :eyes:

Maria: sure — rough draft: 
```json
{
  "promote_steps": [
    {"percent": 0.5, "duration": "4h"},
    {"percent": 2, "duration": "8h"},
    {"percent": 10, "duration": "24h"}
  ],
  "auto_fallback": {
    "mrr_drop_pct": 1.0,
    "hallucination_abs_inc": 0.6,
    "composite_threshold": 1.2,
    "window_mins": 30
  },
  "slices": ["long_doc", "code_generation"]
}
```

Jordan: add a minimum-sample requirement per slice (n >= 500) before auto-fallback can fire. last thing we want is noisy small-sample alerts.

Sam: also suggest we use a smoothed MRR over a 30m rolling window (exp decayed) not instant pts, otherwise transient blips will trigger fallback.

Ashley: what's the rollback runbook? need exact steps for oncall to execute (and a manual abort path in console).

Maria: rollback plan: 1) console abort -> immediate 100% reroute to rwd-v2.4-fp16 fallback, 2) cancel any in-flight promotions, 3) create incident with auto-attached eval snapshot + sample payloads, 4) mark variant as quarantined. we'll wire the console button to a runbook link.

Sam: +1. also can we add an ensemble soft-fallback: if composite metric crosses threshold but per-slice checks are inconclusive, reduce % back to previous stable step instead of full rollback. less churn.

Jordan: agreed. composite metric idea: max(MRR_drop_pct, hallucination_zscore*100) > threshold — that surfaces both accuracy and safety.

Maria: updated config w/ ensemble rollback and sample-size gating: 
```json
{
  "promote_steps": [ {"percent": 0.5, "duration": "4h"}, {"percent": 2, "duration": "8h"} ],
  "auto_fallback": {
    "composite_threshold": 1.2,
    "window_mins": 30,
    "min_sample_per_slice": 500,
    "soft_step_back": true
  }
}
```

Ashley: please add slack notifications to #eng-ml and an explicit manual-override action in runbook. and tag the oncall.

Maria: will do. starting exposure at 0.5% for 4h to be conservative. i opened a PR with gating config and tests.

deploy-bot: rollout job rwd-roll-913 created, starting 0.5% traffic -> rwd-v2.4-int4q at ts=1768765500.

Sam: monitoring stream looks clean so far. pulling smoke evals and long_doc slice in background. link: https://console.redwood.io/evals/12345

Jordan: adding long_doc and code_generation eval slices now — expect initial results in ~12m.

Ashley: thanks — once long_doc slice passes, we can consider next step. please document any micro-regressions in the PR.

Maria: agreed. follow-up check in #eng-ml in 2h. :thumbsup:
